t: 2031 — First coating hulls product ships at scale: MXene inks synthesis
title: 2031 — First coating hulls product ships at scale: MXene inks synthesis
definition: 2031 milestone on the MXene Coating Systems roadmap.
description:
First coating hulls product ships at scale: MXene inks synthesis proven outside the lab.

What must be true first: the MXene inks results have to replicate outside the lab, coating logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and oxidation stability operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed MXene inks demonstrations, coating logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting oxidation stability uptime. When all three flash green, 2031 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (5 years from the 2026 baseline.)

definition: Simulates MXene Coating Systems operating for a day.
description:

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where MXene inks monitoring, coating logistics redundancy, or oxidation stability maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: MXene Coating Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for MXene Coating Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for MXene Coating Systems — mXene 2D materials as functional coatings.

Phase 1 — Prove (MXene inks): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (coating logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (oxidation stability): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (EMI shielding): coating hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and electronics-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
